cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The house is migrating south. Help me redirect it before we lose the driveway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Concrete traps it halfway across the road. Tell him we're planning a route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. It needs a guide.

mechanism: A uses its pupil old route-planning habits to recruit practical cooperation with a migrating-house explanation instead of structural repair.
confusable: Not discovering whether migration is true: A treats it as the useful account and makes B act through it despite a mundane alternative.
comparison: Guiding a house around a road versus negotiating with an office appliance.
